item.title: Troops come under fire in Gaza, reservist seriously wounded; IDF responds with strikes
item.description: Israeli strikes said to kill 9 in Gaza * Ashkelon mayor named as official suspected of pocketing donations * Gaza clan says Israel-backed militia kidnapped 4 members, denies Hamas link The post Troops come under fire in Gaza, reservist seriously wounded; IDF responds with strikes appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Police complete Sde Teiman leak probe, confirm attorney general not involved
item.description: Despite clearing Baharav-Miara, cops pass case to ally of justice minister who still claims she has a conflict of interest; findings to be reviewed by 'external official' The post Police complete Sde Teiman leak probe, confirm attorney general not involved appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Gaza hospitals said to receive bodies of 3 Palestinians killed by IDF fire in past day
item.description: Hamas-run health ministry says 15 others were wounded, without specifying where or when; PM stresses to Witkoff that Israel demands Hamas be disarmed before Strip is reconstructed The post Gaza hospitals said to receive bodies of 3 Palestinians killed by IDF fire in past day appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Shoppers face empty milk shelves as dairy farmers ramp up fight against proposed reform
item.description: Producers agree to resume raw milk supply to processing companies for the time being, though protest convoys to Jerusalem still planned for Wednesday The post Shoppers face empty milk shelves as dairy farmers ramp up fight against proposed reform appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Settlers reportedly assault minor while accompanied by IDF troops who arrested local
item.description: Video shows Israeli aiming cocked gun at Palestinians in southern West Bank hamlet; PA reports 1 killed, 3 wounded during Israeli raid in Jericho The post Settlers reportedly assault minor while accompanied by IDF troops who arrested local appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: UK police open probe into whether former ambassador to US leaked info to Epstein
item.description: British PM says government will cooperate with investigation of Peter Mandelson, who claims he can't recall any payments from the sex offender; former prince Andrew leaves Windsor The post UK police open probe into whether former ambassador to US leaked info to Epstein appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: HIAS closes Vienna office that aided generations of refugees after Trump yanks funding
item.description: Head of immigrant aid group decries move for 'leaving thousands of families in danger,' says it'll fight to ensure US will remain 'a beacon for those fleeing religious oppression' The post HIAS closes Vienna office that aided generations of refugees after Trump yanks funding appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Skirting bans, Iranian products from spices to salves find ways to Israeli stores
item.description: Using 3rd-country loophole, merchants and restaurateurs at Tel Aviv spice market sell authentic goods from Islamic Republic, though closure of Turkey conduit sending prices skyward The post Skirting bans, Iranian products from spices to salves find ways to Israeli stores appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Somaliland president says he expects to soon visit Israel, sign trade agreement
item.description: Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi says Netanyahu invited him to Jewish state, will offer mineral deposits in exchange for access to Israeli technology: 'The sky is the limit' The post Somaliland president says he expects to soon visit Israel, sign trade agreement appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Three men killed in highway shooting that police link to blood feud
item.description: Victims, residents of Arab Israeli town of Tira, apparently lose control of their car and smash into bus after being shot at; police arrest three suspects The post Three men killed in highway shooting that police link to blood feud appeared first on The Times of Israel.
